privileged_info_for_vlm: The target Semi-Major Axis (SMA) is 7571.14 km. The tolerance for the final SMA is 1.0 km and the final phase difference (absolute difference in True Anomaly) must be less than 0.5 degrees. The expected wait time for the drift phase should be at least 40 minutes (approx 0.66 hours). The force model must be 'Point Mass Earth' (Two-Body). The script must be saved to ~/GMAT_output/spare_phasing.script and the report to ~/GMAT_output/phasing_results.txt.
